authorInfo.bio: James Bruce, 8th Earl of Elgin and 12th Earl of Kincardine, was a British colonial administrator and diplomat. He served as Governor of Jamaica (1842–1846), Governor General of the Province of Canada (1847–1854), and Viceroy of India (1862–1863). He is also noted for his role during the Second Opium War.

description: "Letters and Journals of James, Eighth Earl of Elgin" by Earl of James Bruce Elgin is a historical account likely written in the late 19th century. The work chronicles the life and significant moments of Lord Elgin, who served in various high-profile positions including Governor of Jamaica, Governor-General of Canada, and Viceroy of India.
